name: Guatemala (1843–1851)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue, with the coat of arms of 1843, a shield within a wreath, in the centre.
history: Flag of the independent State of Guatemala from 1843, with the new arms of that year in the centre of the Central American triband. It was replaced on 14 November 1851, when the conservative government of Rafael Carrera added the Spanish colours red and yellow to the flag.
